classification.difficultyReason: Select two overlapping right triangles, obtain an intermediate shared height or two horizontal lengths, then subtract to isolate the requested segment without supplied intermediate steps.

content.prompt: Find the value of $x$, correct to 1 decimal place, in these triangles.

spec.description: Two right triangles share the vertical left side. The interior base point separates dimensioned segments 5 and x.
spec.mathematics: The smaller triangle has base 5 and base angle 45°. The outer triangle has base 5+x and base angle 30°. Both have their right angle at the lower-left vertex.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; the shared height and answer are omitted.

answer.worked:
Let $h$ be the shared vertical side.
$$\begin{align*}\tan45^\circ&=\frac{h}{5}\\h&=5\tan45^\circ\\h&=5\\\tan30^\circ&=\frac{5}{5+x}\\(5+x)\tan30^\circ&=5\\5+x&=\frac{5}{\tan30^\circ}\\x&=\frac{5}{\tan30^\circ}-5\\x&\approx3.7\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two right triangles share the right-hand vertical side of length 3. The upper partial segment x ends at the interior segment. The 60° angle retains its external label and pointer.
spec.mathematics: The outer left angle is 20°. The smaller triangle has a 60° angle between its rightward top side and descending interior side. The top-right corner is a right angle.
spec.answerVisibility: The diagram contains x, 3, 20° and 60° only.

answer.worked:
Let $L$ be the full horizontal side and $s$ the smaller triangle's horizontal side.
$$\begin{align*}\tan20^\circ&=\frac{3}{L}\\L\tan20^\circ&=3\\L&=\frac{3}{\tan20^\circ}\\\tan60^\circ&=\frac{3}{s}\\s\tan60^\circ&=3\\s&=\frac{3}{\tan60^\circ}\\x&=L-s\\x&=\frac{3}{\tan20^\circ}-\frac{3}{\tan60^\circ}\\x&\approx6.5\end{align*}$$
